scope: The taskbar now puts its existing read-only recovery control first when recovery is needed. The actual Refused frame moved it from x803 outside a 540px action region to x1, width120. Real other-output activation receives one native implicit-transfer-required Refused receipt; pin/workspace/geometry/draft and peer focus remain authoritative. Actual peer keyboard input is preserved before recovery. Clicking the visible recovery issues observations without retry or launch. Current browser and native Pending/Refused/Unknown regressions pass with normal cleanup.
missingObservations: Independent original-scenario review against the frozen interaction oracle and exact source/core/plugin/toolchain remains open.

Native primary keyboard invocation and applicable AT invocation/feedback for taskbar-refusal remain unqualified. Actual peer keyboard delivery after pointer refusal is not keyboard primary invocation. Audible speech/braille and other refusal causes remain separate.

Recovery is observed without scrolling in the default two-family native viewport and at 320px in a compiled component. Existing user scroll position, denser pin/group arrangements and all input/AT modes remain separate.
Hardware/AT/IME breadth, resource/journey budgets, reproducible package and reversible deployment/rollback remain release obligations.

retainedFailures.setup-failed: Peer was mapped on the other output but lacked declared active focus; fixture now initializes that initial scene before GUI action. No post-action focus workaround.
retainedFailures.recovery-offscreen-failed: Real enabled recovery control at x803 beyond 540px action region; actual source layout defect.
retainedFailures.legacy-native-oracle-failed: Old visual aria-live polite assertion conflicts with existing scoped single-announcer architecture. Current regression asserts visual aria-live off and preserves physical/native/feedback/no-replay checks. No AT/speech acceptance inferred.
retainedFailures.legacy-authority-baseline-failed: Old checker compares effect/dispatch sources to GUI143 ancestry although later product revisions changed those sources. Current regression seals them to qualified current build inputs; originals retained.

protectedAdmission: Initial current native feedback launch returned 75 before any campaign while CPU QA held the protected scope. It was launched after CPU terminal; deadlines and coordinator unchanged.
